postprocess_config.anchor_rule: one distinct numeric C coordinate within radius; conflicting coordinates leave free corner fixed
postprocess_config.degenerate_rule: free only: exact repeated coordinate or exactly zero FP64 cross product
postprocess_config.duplicate_rule: free only: same three numeric coordinates ignoring winding; C wins, then first retained free source face
postprocess_config.free_rule: lexicographic original-point representatives; nearest existing representative within radius; no transitive unions or means
postprocess_config.known_vertex_identity: FP32 coordinate bytes, including signed zero
postprocess_config.normalization: NONE; never normalize the generated bbox
postprocess_config.radius_limit: Single engineering threshold; original paper runtime units are not fully traceable

blend_definition.weights: Every source vertex ID has total observation weight 1; all proposal corner copies retained.
blend_definition.support_fade: sum alpha = min(sum s,1); no support gives exactly zero displacement
blend_definition.arithmetic: FP64 kernel/weights/blend; FP32 output; no matrix solve and no random numbers
blend_definition.theoretical_bound: norm(u(x)) <= max(norm(b_i) for s_i(x)>0); maximum of empty set is zero
blend_definition.actual_bound: norm(F_out_FP32-F_hat_FP32) <= min(0.02L,max participating norm(b)); checked in FP64 after rounding
blend_definition.clipping: Radial projection to per-corner bound, then one conservative FP32 nextafter toward the original free corner only where rounding exceeds the bound. Failure raises; no fallback deformation.
blend_definition.output: Original C bytes copied unchanged; free faces and corner order unchanged
blend_definition.limitations: No source/free correspondence, shared-edge, winding, semantic-use, collision, or fold-free guarantee

orientation_definition.variables: One binary face reversal; every C face is fixed to zero
orientation_definition.constraints: All indexed C-C/C-F/F-F edges with exactly two distinct nondegenerate incident faces: same original edge direction requires XOR1, opposite requires XOR0
orientation_definition.degenerate: Repeated vertex IDs or exactly zero FP64 triangle area; no near-zero threshold introduced
orientation_definition.components: Connected components of the eligible two-incidence constraint graph, including isolated faces
orientation_definition.repair: If parity-consistent and all fixed C anchors compatible, apply the unique anchored solution or an unanchored solution with minimum face ID unflipped; conflicted components remain entirely unchanged
orientation_definition.reversal: Per-face vertex order [0,2,1]; C face rows preserved byte-for-byte
orientation_definition.exclusions: Nonmanifold incidence, boundary edges, self-incidence, or a degenerate incident face produce no XOR constraint and are explicitly listed
orientation_definition.limitations: No vertex-link manifold, collision, overlap, watertightness, or semantic-attachment certificate. Duplicate faces are not repaired or removed.

protocol.selection: Same six USER_MIX parents x two frozen noises; no selection by new results
protocol.order: First orientation D0/RBF, then12BLEND, GEO_C, quality, BLEND orientation; all36 receive same solver
protocol.quality_after_orientation: Reused orientation-independent scalar/geometry evidence; exact triangle vertex sets checked; no full rescoring of flip-only outputs
protocol.graph_after_orientation: Existing legal pair classifications reused; only winding and constrained feasibility newly calculated
protocol.boundary: All original C source-topology open vertices; descriptive, no must-join interface registered
protocol.workers: CPU measured first job; max2 workers and2threads each; GPU0
protocol.replay: Completed receipts reused after hashes; incomplete attempted scientific stage blocks, no automatic retry
protocol.stop: Fixed panel, full per-output evidence, visual review, report, small ZIP; no defaults/commit/push/scan
